rules.description: Team membership or org ownership required to access team endpoints
rules.condition: User is not site admin AND not org owner AND not team member
rules.action: Return 404 (if not org member) or 403 (if org member but not team member)
rules.code_snippet: if isOrgMember { ctx.APIError(http.StatusForbidden, "Must be a team member") } else { ctx.APIErrorNotFound() }

rules.description: Admin-level access to repository required to add/remove it from a team
rules.condition: User's access level to the repository is less than AccessModeAdmin
rules.code_snippet: if access < perm.AccessModeAdmin { ctx.APIError(http.StatusForbidden, "Must have admin-level access to the repository") }

rules.description: Repository must belong to the team's organization
rules.action: Return error 'repository does not belong to organization'
rules.code_snippet: if repo.OwnerID != t.OrgID { return errors.New("repository does not belong to organization") }

rules.description: Adding a repo to a team is idempotent - no error if already present
rules.condition: HasTeamRepo returns true (repo already in team)
rules.code_snippet: } else if organization.HasTeamRepo(ctx, t.OrgID, t.ID, repo.ID) { return nil }

rules.description: Removing a repo from a team that includes all repos is silently ignored
Auto-watch repos for team members when adding repo to team (if setting enabled)
rules.code_snippet: if setting.Service.AutoWatchNewRepos { ... for _, u := range t.Members { repo_model.WatchRepo(ctx, u, repo, true) } }

rules.description: Unwatch and remove issue watches for members who lose access when repo removed from team
rules.condition: Member has no other access to the repo after team removal
rules.action: Unwatch repo and remove issue watches for that member
rules.code_snippet: has, err := access_model.HasAnyUnitAccess(ctx, member.ID, repo) ... if !has { repo_model.WatchRepo(ctx, member, repo, false) }

rules.description: Non-admin users can only search teams they belong to
rules.action: Add UserID filter to search options, limiting results to user's teams

rules.description: Team search defaults to including description in search
rules.condition: include_desc param is empty string (not provided)

rules.description: N+1 permission check pattern in GetTeamRepos - each repo requires individual permission lookup
rules.condition: For each repo in the team
rules.code_snippet: for i, repo := range teamRepos { permission, err := access_model.GetDoerRepoPermission(ctx, repo, ctx.Doer) }
